flowGuide.toggle: Annual Performance Flow Guide (click to expand)
stepsEmployee: [Goal Setting] After HR creates the cycle, fill in your personal SMART goals and submit for manager approval
[Employee Review] When HR advances the cycle, the system generates your performance form — complete your self-review
After submitting, your direct supervisor will conduct the initial review
[Supervisor Review → Calibration] After calibration, the manager publishes results — you can view your final rating
If you disagree with the result, you may submit an appeal
stepsSupervisor: [Goal Setting] After employees fill in their goals, approve your direct reports' goals
[Supervisor Review] After employees submit their self-review, conduct the initial review
Read the self-review, write feedback, and select a rating (O/S+/S/S-/I/U)
After you submit, the manager enters the calibration phase to adjust and publish
stepsManager: [Goal Setting / In Progress] Add custom questions to the department's published template
[Calibration] After employee self-reviews and supervisor reviews are complete, enter the calibration phase
Compare all employee ratings, adjust rankings as needed (go to 'Team Reviews' → 'Enter Calibration')
After confirming, click 'Publish All' to release all results at once
stepsRegionalHR: Create performance cycles: set region, type (Annual/Quarterly/Probation), and date ranges
Create form templates: set applicable grades and titles; Managers can add custom questions
Publish the template, then advance the cycle to 'Employee Review'
The system checks for published templates and auto-creates review forms for all employees
Continue advancing: Supervisor Review → Calibration → Completed
stepsAdmin: Manage performance cycles for all regions (editable during the goal-setting phase)
Monitor review progress across regions; confirm template publishing and cycle advancement
Review the Audit Log to verify system operation records
